subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Baffle
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Baffle"** means to totally bewilder or perplex; to confuse someone completely. (हक्का-बक्का करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The complex instructions managed to** baffle** everyone in the room.
 
 
 
• **"Confuse"** means to make someone unable to think clearly or to understand something. (भ्रमित करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The sudden change in schedule might **confuse** the participants.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the **synonym** of **'Baffle'** is **'Confuse'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Barbarous** (बर्बर): Extremely brutal or cruel.

 
 
• **Example:** The barbarous acts of the invaders shocked everyone.
 
 
 
• **Explicate** (व्याख्या करना): To explain or analyze something in detail.
 
 
• **Example: **The professor asked the students to explicate the poem.
 
 
 
• **Equalise** (समान करना): To make things equal in size, quantity, or value.
 
 
• **Example:** The government aims to equalise opportunities for all citizens.
 
 

47:Ta26,
The correct answer is Option 2&
